Advanced Audio Transcription Project

This project provides a powerful and customizable Python script for transcribing audio from files or real-time microphone input. It leverages state-of-the-art models via Hugging Face and whisperX to deliver high-quality transcriptions with advanced features.

Key Features

High-Quality Transcription: Utilizes OpenAI's Whisper models through whisperX for accurate transcription.

Speaker Diarization: Automatically identifies and separates different speakers in the audio.

Word-level Timestamps: Generates precise start and end times for each transcribed word.

Language Detection: Automatically detects the language of the audio.

Voice Activity Detection (VAD): Intelligently filters out non-speech segments.

Input Flexibility: Transcribe from pre-recorded audio/video files or in real-time.

Checkpointing: Automatically saves progress, allowing you to resume lengthy transcriptions without starting over.

Customization: Provides extensive command-line options to control every aspect of the transcription process, from model selection to feature toggling.

Progress Bars: Visual feedback on the transcription progress.

Setup Instructions

1. Prerequisites

Python 3.8+

FFmpeg: A command-line tool for audio/video processing.

macOS (via Homebrew): brew install ffmpeg

Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt update && sudo apt install ffmpeg

Windows: Download the binary from the official website and add it to your system's PATH.

2. Get Hugging Face Access Token

Speaker diarization requires the pyannote/speaker-diarization-pipeline model, which needs you to accept user conditions on the Hugging Face Hub.

Visit the model card for pyannote/speaker-diarization-pipeline-2.1 and accept the terms.

Visit the model card for pyannote/segmentation and accept the terms.

Go to your Hugging Face account settings and create an access token with read permissions. You will need to provide this token when running the script if you enable diarization.

3. Install Dependencies

It is highly recommended to use a virtual environment.

# Create and activate a virtual environment
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows, use `venv\Scripts\activate`

# Install dependencies from requirements.txt
pip install -r requirements.txt


Note on CUDA: For GPU acceleration, ensure you have a compatible version of PyTorch installed for your CUDA toolkit. The requirements.txt file includes the CPU version of PyTorch. Visit the PyTorch website for instructions on installing a CUDA-enabled version.

Usage Examples

The script is run from the command line using main.py.

Basic Transcription (File)

python main.py path/to/your/audio.mp3 --model "large-v2" --device "cuda"


Transcription with Speaker Diarization

You will be prompted to enter your Hugging Face token the first time.

python main.py meeting.wav --diarize --hf_token "YOUR_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN"


Resume from Checkpoint

If the script is interrupted, it automatically creates a checkpoint file. Simply run the same command again to resume.

# If this was interrupted, run it again to resume from the last completed chunk.
python main.py long_podcast.mp4 --diarize --model "large-v2"


Real-time Transcription

Transcribes from your default microphone. Press Ctrl+C to stop. This mode is best for a single speaker.

python main.py realtime


For a full list of options, run:

python main.py --help

import argparse
import json
from transcriber import AdvancedTranscriber


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Advanced Audio Transcription CLI")

    parser.add_argument(
        "input",
        type=str,
        help="Path to the audio/video file or 'realtime' for microphone input.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--model",
        type=str,
        default="large-v2",
        help="Whisper model name (e.g., 'tiny', 'base', 'large-v2').",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--device",
        type=str,
        default="cpu",
        choices=["cpu", "cuda"],
        help="Device to use for computation.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--language",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Language code (e.g., 'en', 'es'). Auto-detects if not specified.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--diarize", action="store_true", help="Enable speaker diarization."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--hf_token",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Hugging Face token for pyannote.audio speaker diarization.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output_file",
        type=str,
        default="../output/transcription.txt",
        help="File to save the formatted transcription.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output_json",
        type=str,
        default="../output/transcription.json",
        help="File to save the raw JSON output.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--checkpoint_path",
        type=str,
        default="../output/transcription_checkpoint.json",
        help="Path for checkpointing.",
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--aggregate", action="store_true", help="Enable aggregated output format."
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    # --- Initialize Transcriber ---
    # For GPU, you might want a more specific compute type
    compute_type = "int8" if args.device == "cpu" else "float16"
    transcriber = AdvancedTranscriber(
        model_name=args.model,
        device=args.device,
        compute_type=compute_type,
        hf_token=args.hf_token,
    )

    # --- Choose Mode: File or Real-time ---
    if args.input.lower() == "realtime":
        transcriber.transcribe_realtime()
    else:
        # --- File Transcription ---
        result = transcriber.transcribe_file(
            audio_path=args.input,
            language=args.language,
            diarize=args.diarize,
            checkpoint_path=args.checkpoint_path,
        )

        if result and "segments" in result:
            # --- Speaker Name Customization (Interactive) ---
            speaker_names = {}
            if args.diarize:
                unique_speakers = sorted(
                    list(
                        set(
                            seg.get("speaker", "SPEAKER_UNKNOWN")
                            for seg in result["segments"]
                        )
                    )
                )
                print("\n--- Speaker Renaming ---")
                print("Default speaker names found:", ", ".join(unique_speakers))
                for speaker in unique_speakers:
                    new_name = input(
                        f"Enter new name for {speaker} (or press Enter to keep default): "
                    )
                    if new_name.strip():
                        speaker_names[speaker] = new_name.strip()

            # --- Save Outputs ---

                formatted_text = transcriber.format_aggregated_output(result, speaker_names)
            else:
                formatted_text = transcriber.format_output(result, speaker_names)

            with open(args.output_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

            print(f"\nFormatted transcription saved to {args.output_file}")

            # Save the raw JSON for further processing

            print(f"Raw JSON output saved to {args.output_json}")

            # Print to console as well

            print(formatted_text)
        else:

import whisperx
import torch
import os
import json
import librosa
import soundfile as sf
from pydub import AudioSegment
from tqdm import tqdm
import sounddevice as sd
import numpy as np
import time


class AdvancedTranscriber:
    """
    A sophisticated transcriber class that integrates WhisperX for transcription,
    voice activity detection (VAD), and speaker diarization.
    """

    def __init__(
        self, model_name="large-v2", device="cpu", compute_type="float16", hf_token=None
    ):
        """
        Initializes the transcriber with specified models and settings.
        Args:
            model_name (str): The name of the Whisper model to use.
            device (str): The device to run the models on ('cpu' or 'cuda').
            compute_type (str): The compute type for the model (e.g., 'float16', 'int8').
            hf_token (str): Hugging Face token for speaker diarization.
        """
        self.device = device
        self.compute_type = compute_type
        self.model_name = model_name
        self.hf_token = hf_token

        print("Loading Whisper model...")
        self.model = whisperx.load_model(
            self.model_name, self.device, compute_type=self.compute_type
        )
        print("Whisper model loaded.")

        self.diarize_model = None
        if self.hf_token:
            print("Loading speaker diarization model...")
            try:
                from pyannote.audio import Pipeline

                self.diarize_model = Pipeline.from_pretrained(
                    "pyannote/speaker-diarization-pipeline-2.1",
                    use_auth_token=self.hf_token,
                )
                self.diarize_model.to(torch.device(self.device))
                print("Diarization model loaded.")
            except Exception as e:
                print(
                    f"Could not load diarization model. Please check your Hugging Face token and agreement to model terms. Error: {e}"
                )
                self.diarize_model = None

    def _load_audio(self, audio_path, sample_rate=16000):
        """Loads and resamples audio to the required format."""
        try:
            # Using librosa for robust loading
            wav, sr = librosa.load(audio_path, sr=sample_rate)
            if len(wav.shape) > 1:
                wav = librosa.to_mono(wav)
            return wav
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error loading audio file: {e}")
            return None

    def transcribe_file(
        self,
        audio_path,
        language=None,
        diarize=False,
        chunk_size=30,
        checkpoint_path="checkpoint.json",
    ):
        """
        Transcribes an audio file with optional diarization and checkpointing.
        Args:
            audio_path (str): Path to the audio or video file.
            language (str): Language code for transcription. If None, it's auto-detected.
            diarize (bool): Whether to perform speaker diarization.
            chunk_size (int): Size of audio chunks in seconds for processing.
            checkpoint_path (str): Path to save and load transcription progress.

        Returns:
            dict: The final transcription result.
        """
        
        try:
            from rich.progress import Progress, SpinnerColumn, BarColumn, TextColumn
            from rich.console import Console
            console = Console()
        except ImportError:
            console.log("Rich library not found. Please install it with \"pip install rich\"")
            # fallback to simple print
            def console_log(x):
                print(x)
            console = type('obj', (object,), {'log' : console_log})()


        # Load audio
        console.log(f":floppy_disk: Loading audio from: {audio_path}")
        audio = self._load_audio(audio_path)
        if audio is None:
            return {"error": "Failed to load audio."}

        # Check for checkpoint
        processed_segments = []
        start_time = 0
        if os.path.exists(checkpoint_path):
            with open(checkpoint_path, "r") as f:
                processed_segments = json.load(f)
                if processed_segments:
                    last_segment = processed_segments[-1]
                    start_time = last_segment["end"]
                    console.log(
                        f":arrow_right: Resuming transcription from checkpoint at {start_time:.2f} seconds."
                    )

        total_duration = len(audio) / 16000
        
        tasks = [
            ("Transcription", self.model.transcribe),
            ("Alignment", whisperx.align),
            ("Diarization", self.diarize_model),
        ]

        with Progress(
            SpinnerColumn(),
            TextColumn("[progress.description]{task.description}"),
            BarColumn(),
            TextColumn("[progress.percentage]{task.percentage:>3.0f}%"),
            transient=True,
        ) as progress:
            
            # --- Transcription ---
            task1 = progress.add_task("[red]Transcribing...", total=total_duration)
            
            result = self.model.transcribe(audio, language=language, batch_size=16)
            progress.update(task1, completed=total_duration)

            # --- Language Detection ---
            detected_language = result["language"]
            console.log(f":earth_americas: Detected language: {detected_language}")

            # --- Word Alignment ---
            task2 = progress.add_task("[green]Aligning...", total=len(result["segments"]))
            model_a, metadata = whisperx.load_align_model(
                language_code=detected_language, device=self.device
            )
            aligned_result = whisperx.align(
                result["segments"],
                model_a,
                metadata,
                audio,
                self.device,
                return_char_alignments=False,
            )
            progress.update(task2, completed=len(result["segments"]))


            final_result = {"language": detected_language, "segments": []}

            # --- Speaker Diarization ---
            if diarize and self.diarize_model:
                task3 = progress.add_task("[cyan]Diarizing...", total=total_duration)
                diarize_segments = self.diarize_model(
                    {"waveform": torch.from_numpy(audio[None, :]), "sample_rate": 16000},
                    num_speakers=None,
                )
                progress.update(task3, completed=total_duration)
                
                console.log(":busts_in_silhouette: Assigning speakers to segments...")
                final_result = whisperx.assign_word_speakers(
                    diarize_segments, aligned_result
                )
            else:
                final_result["segments"] = aligned_result[
                    "segments"
                ]  # Use aligned segments if no diarization

        # --- Save Checkpoint and Progress ---
        with open(checkpoint_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump(final_result["segments"], f, indent=2)

        console.log(":white_check_mark: Transcription complete.")
        os.remove(checkpoint_path)  # Clean up checkpoint on success
        return final_result

    def transcribe_realtime(self, sample_rate=16000, chunk_duration=5):
        """
        Transcribes audio from the microphone in real-time.
        This is a simplified implementation for single-speaker scenarios.
        """
        print("\nStarting real-time transcription. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")

        try:
            while True:
                print("Listening...")
                # Record a chunk of audio
                audio_chunk = sd.rec(
                    int(chunk_duration * sample_rate),
                    samplerate=sample_rate,
                    channels=1,
                    dtype="float32",
                )
                sd.wait()  # Wait for recording to complete

                # Convert to a 1D numpy array
                audio_np = audio_chunk.flatten()

                # Transcribe the captured chunk
                result = self.model.transcribe(audio_np, language=None)

                if result["segments"]:
                    # Simple VAD: only print if something was transcribed
                    text = " ".join([segment["text"] for segment in result["segments"]])
                    print(f">> {text.strip()}")
                else:
                    print(">> (No speech detected)")

                time.sleep(0.1)  # Small pause

        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\nStopping real-time transcription.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"An error occurred during real-time transcription: {e}")

    @staticmethod
    def format_aggregated_output(result, speaker_names=None):
        """Formats the transcription result by aggregating text by speaker."""
        if not result or "segments" not in result:
            return "No transcription result to format."

        if speaker_names is None:
            speaker_names = {}

        output = f"Language: {result.get('language', 'N/A')}\n\n"
        
        current_speaker = None
        current_text = ""
        start_time = 0

        for i, segment in enumerate(result["segments"]):
            speaker = segment.get("speaker", "SPEAKER_UNKNOWN")
            display_speaker = speaker_names.get(speaker, speaker)
            text = segment.get("text", "").strip()

            if current_speaker is None:
                current_speaker = display_speaker
                start_time = segment.get("start", 0)

            if current_speaker != display_speaker:
                end_time = result["segments"][i-1].get("end", 0)
                output += f"[{current_speaker} {start_time:.2f}s -> {end_time:.2f}s]: {current_text}\n"
                current_speaker = display_speaker
                current_text = ""
                start_time = segment.get("start", 0)

            current_text += f"{text} "
        
        end_time = result["segments"][-1].get("end", 0)
        output += f"[{current_speaker} {start_time:.2f}s -> {end_time:.2f}s]: {current_text}\n"

        return output

    @staticmethod
    def format_output(result, speaker_names=None):
        """Formats the transcription result for easy reading."""
        if not result or "segments" not in result:
            return "No transcription result to format."

        if speaker_names is None:
            speaker_names = {}

        output = f"Language: {result.get('language', 'N/A')}\n\n"

        for segment in result["segments"]:
            speaker = segment.get("speaker", "SPEAKER_UNKNOWN")
            display_speaker = speaker_names.get(speaker, speaker)
            start_time = segment.get("start", 0)
            end_time = segment.get("end", 0)
            text = segment.get("text", "").strip()

            output += (
                f"[{display_speaker} {start_time:.2f}s -> {end_time:.2f}s]: {text}\n"
            )

        return output
